一、 评估的核心维度
微调后的模型评估通常需要从以下四个维度展开：
1.特定任务能力 (Task-Specific Performance)
评估模型在微调目标领域的表现（如：医疗问答、代码生成、公文写
作、信息抽取）。这是微调最直接的目的。
2.通用能力保持 (General Capabilities / 灾难性遗忘检测)
检查模型在微调后，是否遗忘了基座模型原有的常识推理、语言理解、
逻辑推理等通用能力。
3.指令遵循与格式控制 (Instruction Following)
评估模型是否能严格遵守复杂的 Prompt 指令（如：字数限制、输出
特定 JSON 格式、包含特定关键词）。
4.安全性与对齐 (Safety & Alignment)
评估模型是否会产生幻觉（Hallucination）、毒性输出、偏见，以及
是否具备适当的拒答能力（防止过度拒答 Over-refusal）。
二、 评估方法

Boundary-Supplementary Network for Carotid
Plaque Segmentation in Ultrasound Images
Xinjian Zhu , Bingbing Cheng, Y uqiang Shen, Bin Xia, and Guanghui Y ue
Abstract—Accurate measurement of carotid plaques in
ultrasound images is essential for the early preventionand
intervention of stroke. However, carotid plaques exhibit complex
and diverse shapes, with blurry and irregular boundaries, making
this task very challenging. This paper proposes a novel Boundary-
Supplementary Network (BSNet) for carotid plaque segmentation.
BSNet follows an encoder-decoder structure and incorporates two
essential modules: the Multi-Scale Attention Module (MSAM) and
the Boundary-Supplementary Module (BSM). MSAM is deployed
at each layer to comprehensively analyze the feature at different
spatial scales and dynamically fuse multi-scale features using the
attention mechanism. It aids the network in better recognizing
carotid plaques with irregular shapes. BSM incorporates the
outputs of the MSAM at the current and adjacent high layer with
the prediction map of the adjacent high layer to enhance boundary
regions. Through top-down deep supervision, BSNet can accurately
localize the carotid plaque regions with clear boundaries. Extensive
experiments on a collected dataset demonstrate that BSNet outper-
forms 8 state-of-the-art methods in carotid plaque segmentation.
Index Terms —Deep neural network, carotid plaque segment-
ation, multi-scale attention, boundary-supplementary, ultrasound
images.

methods by updating them from different aspects. For instance,
Oktay et al. [12] introduced an attention mechanism that au-
tomatically focuses on important regions within the image,
improving segmentation performance while maintaining fast
inference speeds. Fu et al. [13] incorporated both channel and
spatial attention mechanisms, enabling the automatic selection
and enhancement of features relevant to the segmentation task.
Alom et al. [14] introduced a U-Net-based recurrent residual
convolutional network, which improves feature accumulation by
incorporating residual units. Based on U-Net, Song et al. [15]
proposed a conﬁdence regularized co-teaching algorithm, which
effectively addresses image annotation errors by training two
‘twin’ models and leveraging their prediction discrepancies.
Although the literature has emerged many DNN-based general-
purpose segmentation methods, methods speciﬁc for carotid
plaque segmentation remain insufﬁcient.
In recent years, increasing methods for carotid plaque seg-
mentation have been proposed. To automatically segment
carotid plaque, Vila et al. [16] captured multi-scale contextual
information through feature map concatenation in DenseNet.
Meshram et al. [17] incorporated dilated convolutions into U-
Net, which improved the model’s ability to capture both global
context and ﬁne details for carotid plaque segmentation. To
enhance the model’s accuracy in complex and noisy images,
Jain et al. [18] incorporated SegNet’s contextual understanding
with U-Net’s ability in capturing ﬁne details. Loizou et al. [19]
employed blood ﬂow images to detect the initial plaque contour,
followed by despeckling ﬁlters and a snake model to deform
the initial contour, optimizing the ﬁtting of the plaque bound-
aries. Despite advancements, current methods remain in the ex-
ploratory phase, leaving much room for performance improve-
ment. This study proposes a novel Boundary-Supplementary
Network (BSNet) for automated carotid plaque segmentation
in ultrasound images. BSNet adopts an encoder-decoder archi-
tecture, with the pre-trained PVTv2-B2 [20] as the backbone
of the encoder. First, BSNet deploys an Multi-Scale Attention
Module (MSAM) at each layer of the encoder to adaptively fuse
the features at different spatial scales. The MSAM helps the net-
work better recognize carotid plaques with irregular shapes and
sizes. Subsequently, BSNet utilizes a Boundary-Supplementary

Through progressively connecting BSMs from top to down,
BSNet achieves precise segmentation results. Overall, this paper
makes three contributions:r We constructed a new dataset, named CP-Seg, comprising
4,000 carotid plaque images and their corresponding pixel-
wise annotations to advance the development of automated

II. M ETHODS
A. Overview of Architecture
Fig. 1 depicts the architecture of BSNet, which consists of
two main modules: MSAM and BSM. The MSAM captures
both global and local information to identify carotid plaques
of varying shapes. After the MSAM, the BSM is employed to
improve the model’s boundary ﬁtting capability and increase
segmentation accuracy. Speciﬁcally, the input image is initially
passed through the backbone (PVTv2-B2 [20]) to extract multi-
layer features fi ∈ RW/2i×H/2i×Ci , where W and H are the
width and height of the image, respectively, andCi is the channel
number of the i-th layer (i =1 , 2, 3, 4). These multi-layer fea-
tures are then fed into the MSAM for coarse target localization,
resulting inFi ∈ RW/2i×H/2i×32. Subsequently,F2,F3, andF4
are gradually upsampled and fused using an aggregation (AGG)
block to produce a coarse segmentation mapS4, which serves as
the guiding map of the BSM at the fourth layer. The AGG block
performs element-wise multiplication between F2, F3, F4 and
their respective higher-level features (if available). The resulting
multiplied features are concatenated and processed through a
3 × 3 convolution to produce S4. The reason for excluding F1
in the AGG block is that F1 contributes less to the performance
improvement but costs more computational source. The BSM
generates the prediction map Si by combining the outputs (i.e.,
Fi and Fi+1) of the MSAM at the current and adjacent high
layers, along with the prediction map Si+1 from the adjacent
high layer. Finally, the three BSMs generate prediction maps Si
(i =1 , 2, 3) at different resolutions, and S1 is selected as the
ﬁnal segmentation result.
Fig. 2. Structure of the Multi-Scale Attention Module (MSAM).
B. Multi-Scale Attention Module (MSAM)
In ultrasound images, carotid plaques often exhibit signiﬁcant
variations in size, shape, and texture, which is a critical chal-
lenge for accurate segmentation. To cope with this challenge,
we introduce a MSAM, which enhances feature extraction by
incorporating multi-scale processing into self-attention [21].
Unlike traditional self-attention, which operates at a single scale,
the MSAM ﬁrst applies four predeﬁned scale factors ( 1×, 2×,
4×, 8×, where 2×, 4× and 8× denote downsampling by a
factor of 2, 4 and 8, respectively) to Q, K, and V , enabling the
capture of both global and local information. In this process,
low-resolution features (4×, 8×) facilitate the perception of
the overall morphology of large plaques, while high-resolution
features (1×, 2×) aid in observing boundary clarity and texture
details of small plaques. By fusing multi-scale features, the
MSAM is able to enhance feature representation to identify
plaques with varying sizes and shapes.
As illustrated in Fig. 2, Fi is processed through three 3× 3
convolutions to generate Q, K, and V . Subsequently, Q, K,
and V are downsampled using predeﬁned scale factors ( 1×,
2×, 4×, 8×) and projected into different scale spaces, resulting
in Qj , Kj , and Vj (j =1 , 2, 3, 4). In each scale space, the
attention maps wj (j =1 , 2, 3, 4) are computed by multiplying
Qj and Kj , each processed by a 3 × 3 convolution, i.e., wj =

E. Implementation Details
During training BSNet, the Adam optimizer is used with an
initial learning rate of 1e-4. The learning rate is decayed by 0.1
every 20 epochs. BSNet is trained for 100 epochs with a batch
size of 16. Data augmentation (random ﬂipping, rotation) is used
to mitigate overﬁtting. The images are resized to 352 × 352,
and a multi-scale training strategy {0.75, 1.00, 1.25} is used to
enhance generalization. All the experiments are conducted on a
server equipped with four NVIDIA 3090 GPUs and two Intel
Xeon Gold 6226R CPUs.
III. E XPERIMENTS
A. Experimental Details
1) Datasets: In this study, we collected the CP-Seg dataset
for carotid plaque segmentation in ultrasound images, autho-
rized by the Human Body Research Ethics Committee of
the Fourth Afﬁliated Hospital Zhejiang University School of
Medicine (Number: K2024237). All images were acquired us-
ing a Philips EPIQ5 ultrasound system, following the Chinese
standards for vascular ultrasound examination in stroke. Two
attending ultrasound physicians with six years of experience
independently annotated the images. In case of inconsistency,
a senior physician with 15 years of experience re-annotated
the images to ensure accuracy. The CP-Seg dataset consists
of 3,500 ultrasound images and their corresponding pixel-wise
segmentation masks for model training, and an additional 500
ultrasound images as well as segmentation masks for model
test. The image resolution is 352 × 352, and the images were
standardized to remove unnecessary background information for
privacy protection. Fig. 4 shows some examples in the CP-Seg
dataset.
2) Evaluation Metrics: Five evaluation metrics are em-
ployed, including mean dice score (mDice), mean IoU (mIoU ),

indicate better segmentation performance, whereas for MAE ,
smaller values reﬂect superior results.

ﬂoating point operations (FLOPs). As shown in the last column
of Table I, while BSNet (ranking 3 rd) is not the most efﬁcient,
its computational complexity remains reasonable compared to
many popular methods, such as U-Net++, Cara-Net, and I2U-
Net. Notably, this study prioritizes segmentation accuracy over
computational efﬁciency, as precise segmentation is crucial for
disease diagnosis and treatment planning. Considering the need
for efﬁciency in practical applications, we plan to explore model
pruning and lightweight designs in future work.
2) Qualitative Results: Fig. 5 presents a comparative visu-
alization of segmentation results across nine methods in var-
ious lesion scenarios. For small carotid plaques (as shown in
the 3th row), BSNet’s prediction maps exhibit clear plaque
boundaries, while the predictions from some competing methods
show blurred or discontinuous boundaries. For carotid plaques
with irregular shapes and large sizes (see the 4th and 6th
rows), most methods still struggle with signiﬁcant boundary

ambiguity or unclear transitions, making accurate segmentation
more challenging. Nevertheless, BSNet demonstrates superior
performance in detecting the plaque regions with better accu-
racy and clear boundaries. Overall, BSNet outperforms these
competing methods in handling the complex and challenging
carotid plaque segmentation task, exhibiting stronger robustness
and superior performance.
C. Ablation Study
In this study, we conducted ablation experiments to quan-
tify the impact of each module, i.e., MSAM and BSM. All
experiments were performed under the conditions as outlined
in Section II-E. The results, summarized in Table II, present the
mDice and mIoU values due to space limitations.
1) Effectiveness of MSAM: The MSAM is designed to in-
tegrate global and local features across multiple spatial scales,
Here, we replaced the MSAM with a convolutional block while
keeping other components unchanged. As observed in the ﬁrst
and third rows of Table II, the removal of MSAM leads to an
obvious performance drop. Speciﬁcally, the mDice decreases
by 0.2%, while themIoU drops by 0.3%. These results indicate
that MSAM plays a positive role in accurate segmentation.
2) Effectiveness of BSM: The BSM enhances lesion segmen-
tation by reﬁning boundary information. In this experiment, we
replaced BSM by directly concatenatingFi,Fi+1, andSi+1, and
processed the concatenated features using a 1× 1 convolutional
block to generate the prediction map Si. As indicated in the
last two rows of Table II, this modiﬁcation results in a notable
performance degradation. For example, the mDice and mIoU
decrease by 0.8% and 1.0%, respectively. These results demon-
strate that the use of BSM contributes to superior segmentation
performance.
3) Effectiveness of PVTv2-B2: PVTv2-B2 integrates the
Transformer attention mechanism with a pyramid structure,
enabling efﬁcient multi-scale feature extraction while enhancing
accuracy and reducing computational efﬁciency. As shown in
the last three rows of Table I, PVTv2-B2 achieves a 1.8%
increase in mDice over ResNet-34 [29], with only a marginal
increase in FLOPs. Compared to Res2Net-50 [30], it improves
mDice by 1.2% while requiring fewer FLOPs. Given its superior
performance and lower computational efﬁciency, PVTv2-B2 is
chosen as the backbone of BSNet.
IV . CONCLUSION
The study proposes a novel deep neural network, termed
BSNet, for accurately carotid plaque segmentation in ultrasound
images. BSNet utilizes a multi-scale attention module and a
boundary-supplementary module to cope with the challenges
of complex/diverse shapes and blurry/irregular boundaries. Ex-
tensive experiments on a collected demonstrate that, BSNet
shows promising performance on the challenging carotid plaque
segmentation task, with the mDice and mIoU value of 0.814
and 0.698, respectively.

推荐序 1 
 
 
作为经历过大数据技术发展完整历程的科技从业者，我有幸赶上了新一代人工智能技术快速从
理论走向实践、从科研走向产业的发展浪潮。近年来，随着大模型（LLM）和多模态模型技术的演
进，我们正站在一个全新的技术拐点上——人工智能不再仅仅是“玩具”，而是逐步演变为具备感
知、思考、决策与行动能力的 AI Agent 生产力工具。这不仅是技术的跃迁，更是人机协作范式的
一场深刻变革。 
在此背景下，《AI Agent开发全书：原理、框架与企业落地》一书的出版恰逢其时。本书不仅系
统地梳理了 AI Agent 的基础原理与技术架构，更可贵的是，它侧重开发实战与行业应用，突出了企
业级应用落地。全书整体内容结构清晰，重点突出，详略得当：技术原理篇为全书的基础，详细阐述
了 AI Agent 的关键技术与主要模块，以及主要开发框架与MCP 等；落地实战篇是全书的重点，不
仅基于 Coze、Dify 等平台和 LangGraph 等框架构建AI Agent，还结合 ChatBI、智能客服等企业
级应用场景，提供了具有参考价值的实战案例；前沿探索篇探讨了AI Agent 的未来发展趋势，包括
多模态 Agent、具身智能与AGI 发展等。每一章都围绕当前主流技术，循序渐进，不断深入。 
我特别欣赏本书对架构设计与实战落地的强调。在当前 LLM 仍然存在“幻觉”的背景下，如
何让 AI Agent 真正理解环境、响应上下文、执行任务并持续学习，已成为决定其能否在电信、金
融、 工业制造等关键行业落地的核心挑战。 或许， 我们能在本书提到的提示工程、ReAct 框架、Tool 
Calling 机制、记忆能力、多智能体构建、MCP 与通信协同等关键技术中找到答案。 
作为一家以软件开发为主营业务的上市公司 CTO，我深知技术创新必须与商业闭环并重。 AI 
Agent 的真正价值在于它能否自主完成数据分析、客户服务、流程自动化、风险预警等复杂任务，
从而释放人力、提升效率、创造增量价值。本书中的多个实战章节，都是围绕这些高价值场景展开
的，极具启发性和实践指导意义。 
我相信，AI Agent 将成为未来人工智能应用的核心形态，而本书将是每一位 AI 工程师、产品
经理和技术管理者不可或缺的案头指南。 
 
查礼 
北京东方国信科技股份有限公司副总裁兼 CTO 
2025 年 8 月 18 日 
IV∣AI Agent 开发全书：原理、框架与企业落地 
 
 
 
推荐序 2 
 
 
当第一次看到 AI Agent 这个概念时，我脑海中浮现的不仅是技术的演进，更是一场即将席卷
全球的生产力革命。我们正站在一个新时代的门槛上 ——从“人适应机器”走向“机器服务于人”
的智能跃迁。摆在各位面前的本书，正是这场变革中不可或缺的导航图与实践手册。 
《AI Agent 开发全书：原理、框架与企业落地》一书，以系统化、工程化、前沿化的视角，全
面剖析了 AI Agent 的技术本质与发展脉络。它不止于理论，而是打通架构设计、开发框架、行业
场景与未来趋势，形成了从认知到实践的完整闭环。全书结构清晰，层层递进：第1 章对 AI Agent
的本质与历史进行溯源，第 2 章拆解关键技术模块，第 3 章是主流开发框架的横向对比，第 4 章介
绍 AI Agent 的 MCP 与通信协同，第 5、6 章是基于 Coze、Dify 等平台和 LangGraph 等框架
的工程实战，最终延伸至第 7、8 章，介绍 AI Agent 在数据分析、智能客服等企业级场景中的深度
应用，以及第 9、10 章对多模态 Agent 与 AGI 未来的前瞻思考——每一步都紧扣时代脉搏，既有
思想高度，又有落地温度。 
尤为难得的是，本书并未陷入“炫技式”的技术堆砌，而是始终围绕“如何构建真正可用、可
落地、可扩展的 AI Agent 系统”这一核心命题展开。无论是对ReAct 框架的深度剖析、讲解 Tool 
Calling 实现机制，还是介绍记忆管理、多智能体协同、MCP 等关键设计，作者都以极强的工程思
维给出了清晰的路径指引。这在当前 AI 技术浮躁、概念泛滥的背景下，显得尤为珍贵。 
作为北京数致未来科技的创始人， 以及持续深耕AGI 领域的探索者， 我深知： 未来的智能世界，
不是单一模型的胜利，而是由无数具备感知、决策、行动与协作能力的 AI Agent 所构成的生态。
本书，正是帮助开发者、企业架构师、技术决策者、AI 产品经理迈入这一生态的“第一把钥匙”。 
我乐于为这样一本兼具深度与广度、思想性与实操性的著作撰写推荐序。它不仅适合AI 初学者
建立系统认知，也值得资深从业者反复研读。相信每一位认真读完本书的读者，都将获得构建未来
智能系统的底层能力。 
 
孙玄 
北京数致未来科技创始人&CEO 
视频号“玄姐谈 AGI”主理人 
2025 年 8 月 14 日 
前言∣V 
 
 
 
 
前言 
 
 
在人工智能技术迅猛发展的今天，AI Agent（智能体）已成为推动行业变革的核心力量。从简
单的任务自动化到复杂的自主决策系统，AI Agent 正在重塑人机交互的边界，并在企业服务、数据
分析、智能客服、多模态交互等领域展现出巨大的潜力。 
为什么写这本书 
本书的创作源于我在 AI 领域多年的行业观察与技术实践。随着大模型（LLM）和智能体技术
的快速发展，许多开发者与企业虽对 AI Agent 充满兴趣，却面临如下挑战。 
 技术门槛高：AI Agent 开发涉及 LLM、记忆、规划、工具调用等多模块协同，缺乏系统化
的指导。 
 落地经验少：如何将实验室中的智能体技术转化为实际业务场景的解决方案，需要方法论与
案例的支撑。 
 生态碎片化：LangGraph、CrewAI、Google ADK 等框架层出不穷，开发者难以快速选
型并高效应用。 
本书通过“原理+实战+前沿”三位一体的内容设计，帮助读者从零构建 AI Agent，并掌握其
落地应用的核心能力。 
本书核心内容 
本书分为 3 篇，内容层层递进。 
1. 技术原理篇（第 1～4 章） 
 系统解析 AI Agent 的本质、技术框架与核心模块（如 LLM、规划、记忆、工具调用）。 
 深入探讨 AI Agent 开发的关键技术，如提示工程、RAG、函数调用等。 
VI∣AI Agent 开发全书：原理、框架与企业落地 
 
2. 落地实战篇（第 5～8 章） 
 基于 Coze、Dify 等平台和 LangGraph 等框架，手把手地教授读者AI Agent 的开发与部
署。 
 结合企业级案例（如数据分析 AI Agent 、智能客服），剖析架构设计、技术选型与行业
适配。 
3. 前沿探索篇（第 9、10 章） 
展望多模态 Agent、具身智能等前沿方向，并探讨安全、伦理与 AGI 发展的未来挑战。 
本书特色 
 注重实操：包含大量代码示例、架构图与调试技巧，覆盖从开发到部署的全流程。 
 行业导向：聚焦金融、电商、电信等场景，提供可复用的解决方案。 
 前瞻视角：不仅讲解现有技术，更分析 AI Agent 与 AGI 的演进路径。 
致谢 
感谢我的团队与朋友在成书过程中提供的宝贵建议，尤其感谢参与案例实践的企业伙伴，他们
的真实需求让本书的实战内容更具参考价值。此外，感谢编辑团队的细致工作，使复杂的技术内容
得以清晰呈现。 
读者对象 
 开发者：希望掌握 AI Agent 开发全流程的技术人员。 
 企业决策者：寻求 AI Agent 落地场景与架构设计的管理者。 
 研究者：关注智能体技术前沿与 AGI 发展的学者。 
阅读建议
